Name: OURple Grass for Grass Variety
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
A purple type of grass fitting a more cool and spooky setting, comes with seasonal textures!  Slightly redone and more textures that my old More Grass Pack. Future update will include blue grass :)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI, Content Patcher and Grass Variety.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Generally Compatible.
